$comment: Advisory skill auto-activation map (Wave A4; pattern: ChrisWiles/claude-code-showcase, docs/deep-comparison/01-collections.md top adopt). Consulted by the agent at task start: if the operator's request matches `keywords` (intent) or the files about to change match `paths` (globs), SUGGEST the mapped skill before improvising. This file is data, not enforcement — it never overrides CLAUDE.md, the Ask-before list, or a skill's own Skip-when carve-outs. No hook consumes it yet; wiring one is a settings.json change (Ask-before surface).

rules.reason: The pre-build gate: new feature surface needs a contract (lightweight or full track) before code.
Build UI right the first time from the vetted recipes instead of fixing it at design QA.
End-to-end entity scaffold (model + zod + routes + pages + recycling bin) beats hand-wiring.
/ship before every push is a Hard rule — the active gate on the free plan.
Standing instruction: any push touching auth/schemas/API routes/lib gets the pre-push diff review.
Route vague 'test it' asks through the gated orchestrator, not an ad-hoc mega-task.
Fidelity/a11y questions are Tier 1 of QA; theme/token edits invalidate every screen.
Decisions go through the ADR template (MADR drivers + per-option trade-offs), not chat.
gitleaks + npm audit + Semgrep on demand; the first step of /conform.
Growth capabilities have vetted recipes with when-to-add triggers; don't install ad hoc.
A live URL is the default; run the provisioner preflight before claiming access problems.
Durable cross-session knowledge goes to agent-memory via /remember, not chat scrollback.
When the context watchdog warns, hand off at the next milestone instead of degrading.
Repetitive N-file jobs run as capped headless passes, not one long interactive session.
Forks pull template layers via the path-scoped sync, never by cherry-picking blind.
